name: harness-hub
description: Harness Hub monorepo root (SYS-HUB-FOUNDATION-P02 で構成確定)

scripts.check:secrets: node scripts/ci/check-required-package-script.mjs packages/inspection/package.json scan:secrets && pnpm --filter @harness-hub/inspection run scan:secrets
scripts.check:drift: node scripts/ci/check-required-package-script.mjs packages/schemas/package.json check:drift && pnpm --filter @harness-hub/schemas run check:drift
scripts.check:auth: node scripts/ci/check-required-package-script.mjs apps/hub/package.json check:auth-gates && pnpm --filter @harness-hub/hub run check:auth-gates
scripts.check:tenant-isolation: node scripts/ci/check-tenant-isolation-gate.mjs && node scripts/ci/check-required-package-script.mjs apps/hub/package.json test:tenant-isolation && pnpm --filter @harness-hub/hub run test:tenant-isolation
scripts.check:client-bundle: node scripts/ci/check-required-package-script.mjs apps/hub/package.json check:client-bundle && pnpm --filter @harness-hub/hub run check:client-bundle
scripts.check:dynamic-routes: node scripts/ci/check-required-package-script.mjs apps/hub/package.json check:dynamic-routes && pnpm --filter @harness-hub/hub run check:dynamic-routes
scripts.verify: pnpm check:pnpm && pnpm check:duplicates && pnpm check:worker-secrets && pnpm check:auth && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @harness-hub/hub run build:worker && pnpm test && pnpm check:tenant-isolation && pnpm check:secrets && pnpm check:drift && pnpm check:bundle && pnpm check:client-bundle && pnpm check:dynamic-routes
